deployments_detail.use: ABB Ability Genix Industrial Analytics & AI Suite — predictive maintenance, asset performance management, condition monitoring (ABB-disclosed named product)
AI-powered robotics/cobots (ABB Robotics Division; strategic disclosures, no named metric)

Genix Copilot: generative AI embedded in the ABB Ability/Genix Industrial IoT & Analytics platform, enabling natural-language queries over industrial data for operations, asset performance, energy and emissions insights, plus customer self-service support [Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service (GPT-4)]
deployments_detail.value: Up to 35% savings in O&M costs; 30% boost in production efficiency; up to 20% energy/emission optimization; ~80% reduction in level 1/2 service calls

deployments_detail.use: RobotStudio HyperReality: integration of NVIDIA Omniverse libraries into RobotStudio for physical-AI robot simulation, synthetic data generation and virtual training/validation before physical deployment [NVIDIA Omniverse]
deployments_detail.value: 99% sim-to-real correlation; up to 40% lower deployment costs; up to 50% faster time to market; up to 80% reduction in setup/commissioning time

deployments_detail.use: GMD Copilot: AI-powered virtual assistant for gearless mill drive (GMD) maintenance, troubleshooting and decision support in mining operations, delivering instant context-specific answers [ABB (GenAI)]

Generative AI for robotic vision: ABB integrates LandingAI's LandingLens vision-AI platform to rapidly train robot vision systems to recognize objects and patterns for guidance and inspection tasks [LandingAI (LandingLens)]

Asset health and performance management: ABB partners with/invests in UptimeAI to combine machine learning and expert systems for predictive asset-failure insights across industrial customers [UptimeAI (ML + expert systems)]

Deep-learning machine vision integrated into the machine automation control loop for real-time defect/fault detection during high-speed production without slowing the line (edge AI cameras) [ABB (edge deep-learning vision)]

AI-powered energy management: ABB Electrification deploys AI to help commercial and industrial buildings optimize energy demand and supply in real time, reducing operating costs [ABB Electrification (with startup partners incl. GridBeyond)]

My Measurement Assistant+ and Genix Datalyzer: agentic-AI device support copilots providing device-specific troubleshooting, spare-parts identification/ordering, and remote support scheduling for industrial measurement devices in seven languages [Microsoft Foundry / ABB Genix Copilot (agentic AI)]
Internal workplace GenAI: ABB rolls out generative AI tools, training and resources for its employees to use in day-to-day work across the organization [none disclosed]

RobotStudio AI Assistant: generative AI (LLM) assistant inside RobotStudio that lets operators program industrial robots using natural language and get real-time step-by-step programming guidance [ABB (LLM-powered); generative AI]
deployments_detail.value: Cutting robot setup time by up to 70%
